The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b90d91abec2e8614), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 42. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: On the preceding extension of any microscopic subsequential law, let Wr be the upper-left mI-dimensional block of an infinite raw GOE array independent of E, and set Hr = DI + s1ImI + √ s2 Wr. (95) Then, along r = 2j, the raw eigenvalue counting measures ν(r) = mI X j=1 δλj(Hr) =⇒ ν converge in law for the local vague topology, without conditioning. Moreover mI = 2ρK + O(K1−χ) almost surely, and the coefficient bounds (94) hold eventually almost surely.
